name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Descriptor 'tick_summon_anim_variant_e_16slot' accurately reflects the function: a per-tick state machine for the variant-E summon-spell animation over 16 sprite slots. '16slot' is a meaningful array dimension (16 frame-counter slots, 16-byte sprite-base table), 'variant_e' is a meaningful family discriminator (one of variants A/B/C/D/E plus main/minor). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Per-tick state machine for the variant-E 16-slot summon-spell animation (simplest family member: no team adjust, no color rotation, fixed per-slot sprite-base offsets); dispatch-table entry #8 invoked indirectly via the 10-entry table at 0x523B9.
logic_summary: Copies the 16-byte per-slot sprite-base table (data_fd2_animation_summon_variant_e_16slot_sprite_base_table @ 0x52539) into a local. Dispatch on state_code: state 0 (INIT) seeds the 16-slot frame counter with -2*i (staggered start) and returns 3; state 3 returns 0x22 (hold code); state 6 returns 2 (no terminate-flag write, unlike other variants); states 2/5 (TICK, no odd/even gate) iterate all 16 slots: if 0<=frame<8 blit sprite (sprite_id = frame + per-slot base, at fixed origin_y, no per-slot Y offset); trigger SFX on frame==0 (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, sel 1) and frame==4 (fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank, sel 2); increment the slot's counter; set done_flag when a counter reaches 4; return done_flag. Any other state_code returns 0.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_e_16slot(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 sprite_handle, uint32 origin_y, uint32 row_stride, uint32 state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Caster unit index. Unused by this variant (explicitly discarded via (void)caster_unit_id); present only to keep the uniform 5-arg dispatch-table signature shared by all summon-anim tick functions.
params.reason: Accurate; matches sibling tick functions' first parameter. No address residue. Unused-but-uniform is intentional, not a naming defect.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite atlas/handle forwarded to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite as the source sprite set for each per-slot blit.
params.reason: Accurate name for the blit source handle; no address residue.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base destination Y coordinate passed straight to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite; variant-E applies no per-slot Y offset, so the same origin_y is used for every visible slot.
params.reason: Accurate; matches the y/origin argument used by sibling tick functions. No address residue.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride forwarded to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite.
params.reason: Accurate name for the blit row stride argument; no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Animation-phase selector from the caller's dispatch loop: 0=INIT, 3=hold-setup, 6=hold, 2/5=TICK-advance, others=no-op. Only the low byte is compared (Ghidra renders the param as char), but the dispatch table passes a full uint32 and the source keeps uint32 for signature uniformity.
params.reason: Accurate name; clearly the phase selector. No address residue.

returns.semantics: Frame-hold / status code consumed by the caller's dispatch loop: INIT->3, state3->0x22 (hold ticks), state6->2, TICK->done_flag (1 once any slot's counter reaches 4, else 0), other states->0.
